serverInfo.name: Google-Audio
serverInfo.title: Google Audio
serverInfo.description: Create natural speech from text and process audio for voice apps.

instructions: Generate single-speaker speech as inline audio, or create a text-only podcast script from a document. Audio generation can be slow. Public HTTPS input files work with a Google API key; protected SharePoint and OneDrive files require delegated authentication.

headers.description: Google API key for speech and podcast-script generation
